planet_nine.presets: first three sample rows are editable path presets only; regional ranking uses all 100000 source rows with explicit filters
planet_nine.project_time_scale_assumption: TDB; never a measured conversion of the original unknown time scale
planet_nine.reference_ra_dec_reproduction: not_validated; source rounded elements and observer conventions limit comparison

conditional_regions.cell_probability: n/N conditional on literature model, source epoch, selected survey and radius subset
conditional_regions.moving_to_observation: select underlying synthetic orbit row then propagate to requested dates before MOST

dynamics.gravity: Newtonian Sun + eight prescribed planetary systems; optional solar 1PN test-particle correction; optional hypothetical perturber
dynamics.coordinate_frame: heliocentric mean ecliptic and equinox J2000
dynamics.observer: approximate Earth-Moon barycenter or Sun; MOST observer not independently established

most.response_storage: bounded raw response body with SHA256 and complete query parameters in separate hypothesis evidence

legacy_data_policy: preserve original raw data and old release ZIP/Git locally; remove excluded implementation/API/data from active export and new server bundle; preserve observation evidence hashes and explicitly omit retired context on partial restoration
